paper.title: Interactive Task and Concept Learning from Natural Language Instructions and GUI Demonstrations
paper.central_claim: A domain-independent multimodal conversational agent lets end users recursively ground ambiguous task concepts and conditional procedures in mobile-app GUI demonstrations, stores reusable generalized knowledge, and offers usable low-barrier automation authoring.

evidence.quote: users would often use unclear, ambiguous or vague concepts when naturally instructing tasks in natural language, especially when specifying conditionals.
evidence.support_explanation: Authors motivate concept clarification, not autonomous task invention.

evidence.quote: Pumice recursively executes each resolve() function in the parsing result in a depth-first fashion.
evidence.support_explanation: Typed unresolved components cause explicit agent-initiated clarification.

evidence.quote: After a concept is fully resolved (i.e., all concepts used for defining it have been resolved), it is added to a persistent knowledge graph
evidence.support_explanation: Human-defined concepts persist; selection is resolution/confirmation, not an RL improvement test.

evidence.quote: Pumice confirms with the user every time it learns a new concept or a new rule
evidence.support_explanation: Human is part of validation loop and supplies meaning; no autonomous-verifier claim.

evidence.quote: Sugilite provides action recording and replaying capabilities on third-party Android apps using the Android Accessibility API.
evidence.support_explanation: Structured accessibility privilege and inherited execution substrate.

evidence.quote: We did not use a control condition, as we could not find other tools that can feasibly support users with little programming expertise to complete the target tasks.
evidence.support_explanation: No controlled summative attribution experiment; explanation is not evidence of superiority.

evidence.quote: We asked participants to keep trying until they were able to correctly execute the automation, and that they were happy with the resulting actions of the agent. We also checked the scripts at the end of each study session to evaluate their correctness.
evidence.support_explanation: Outcome is eventual user-assisted authoring plus script inspection, not first-attempt autonomous success.

evidence.quote: All participants were able to complete all 4 tasks. The total time for tasks ranged from 19.4 minutes to 25 minutes for the 10 participants.
evidence.support_explanation: 40 task-authoring completions among 10 trained users, measured time denominator explicit.

evidence.quote: all participants had received a tutorial with an example task demonstrated.
evidence.support_explanation: Study success depends on tutorial, known apps, and guidance.

evidence.quote: it only supports single basic Boolean operations (i.e., greater than, less than, equal to)
evidence.support_explanation: Expressivity boundary excludes general logical/arithmetic conditional programming.

evidence.quote: the proposed technique is used in conversations for performing immediate tasks instead of for completely automated rules.
evidence.support_explanation: No unattended ongoing rule-monitoring capability demonstrated.

evidence.quote: for programmers (22.12 minutes, SD=2.40) was slightly shorter than that for non-programmers (23.06 minutes, SD=1.57), but the difference was not statistically significant.
evidence.support_explanation: Time variation reported; small groups cannot establish population-level programming-experience equivalence.

evidence.quote: The inter-rater agreement [ \citeauthoryearCohen1960 ] was κ = 0.87 \kappa=0.87 , suggesting good agreement.
evidence.support_explanation: Formative two-coder reliability, separate from summative task outcome verification.

evidence.quote: We pre-taught Pumice the concept of “hot” in the task domain of turning on the air conditioner.
evidence.support_explanation: Reuse task starts with known concept intentionally preloaded; not independent zero-shot learning.

evidence.quote: The current version of Pumice does not differentiate between personal preferences and generalizable knowledge in learned concepts and procedures.
evidence.support_explanation: Persistent user-local knowledge is not cross-user general capability.

signatures.information: Natural utterance, typed DSL alternatives/confidences, human follow-up speech and demonstrations, app UI graph.
signatures.operation: Insert typed resolve holes; recursively ask value/Boolean/procedure questions depth-first; parse answers or record demonstrations; replace resolved holes.
signatures.output: Executable conditional expression with linked procedures and value queries.
signatures.conditions: Available human familiar with app; parsable single comparisons and accessible native-app values.
signatures.feedback: User confirmation after concepts/rules; ambiguity alternatives; undo/rephrase.
signatures.selection_rule: Fully resolve child concepts and confirm meaning; not evaluation-reward selection.
signatures.selection_data: User confirmation after concepts/rules; ambiguity alternatives; undo/rephrase.
signatures.persistence: Local persistent knowledge graph: trigger utterances, context-specific Boolean expressions, value queries and scripts.
signatures.later_use: Later utterances link/reuse concepts with confirmation of changed context/threshold.
signatures.claimed_effect: Reduce requirement to specify all semantics upfront.
signatures.failure_boundary: Human time and parser misunderstanding; no complex logical/arithmetic conditionals; semantics not autonomously understood.

signatures.information: Accessibility UI snapshots include labels/types/positions/relations, including invisible objects; human selects intended value.
signatures.operation: Ground demonstrations and verbal references to graph queries; parameterize inherited Sugilite scripts; execute conditions and branch procedures.
signatures.output: Reusable local app-query/procedure definitions and immediate execution.
signatures.conditions: Foreground Android accessibility; not games/custom graphic engines, arbitrary web apps, gestures or background polling.
signatures.feedback: Human can inspect, undo, correct; summative study repeats until correct and inspects scripts.
signatures.selection_rule: Store taught/confirmed scripts, not independent later-task reward-based acceptance.
signatures.selection_data: Human can inspect, undo, correct; summative study repeats until correct and inspects scripts.
signatures.later_use: Context-specific reuse including pre-taught hot concept and parameter substitutions.
signatures.claimed_effect: Support cross-domain end-user automation with demonstrations.
signatures.failure_boundary: Immediate conversational tasks only; no unattended monitor, cross-user transfer or measured long-term accumulation gain.

gap.author_gap: End users naturally underspecify ambiguous concepts and conditionals; prior natural-language tools constrain domains, while demonstrations alone do not explain intent.
gap.checked_gap: Formative 58-person elicitation with 33% vs 9% ambiguous descriptions and coder kappa .87 grounds a real interaction bottleneck at the time; general superiority over historical systems is author-attributed only.

gap.stakes: Users cannot conveniently provide complete formal programs or common-sense ontologies.
gap.method_response: Typed unresolved DSL holes guide multimodal clarification and reuse; deterministic scripts/queries ground abstract definitions.
gap.remaining_gap: Semantic limits, human burden, four designed tasks, no comparison arm, no autonomous rules or cross-user knowledge transfer.

gap.current_relevance: Early mixed-initiative conceptual grounding and persistent user knowledge; later ASK-policy criteria are treated as analogical checks, never retroactive benchmark obligations.

tactic_steps_checked: Parse high-level utterance into typed DSL containing unresolved Boolean/value/procedure holes.

success_failure_checks.reason: Typed DSL, Boolean expressions, UI queries and scripts.
User confirmation and interpreter/runtime close loop, but semantic correctness rests on human rather than a sound automatic oracle.

success_failure_checks.condition: Isolate delegation and report human cost
success_failure_checks.reason: 40 eventual completions and time reported; no human-only, NLP-only or modality/delegation ablation.

matches.reason: Main responsibility split is conversational clarification and human-grounded definitions versus executable typed program/query resolution. C25 corresponds only partially: no theorem of semantic soundness and no automatic verification reward.

rs_pattern.reason: Typed DSL and app-query execution provide a genuine responsibility boundary. Merely multimodal inputs do not meet uniform-model unification; ordinary knowledge reuse is not frozen-model C03 adaptation.
rs_pattern.executes_pattern: partial: typed, executable intermediates and construction-time user verification; human semantics prevents automatic solver-soundness claims.
rs_pattern.resolves_problem: scoped: usability and eventual completion on four designed tasks with tutorial, not autonomous general concept learning.

condition_checks.reason: Typed resolve functions trigger questions, explanations and demonstrations.

condition_checks.condition: Real human rather than simulated oracle
condition_checks.reason: Ten recruited users operate third-party apps.

condition_checks.condition: Asking precision/recall, threshold and autonomous/human controls
condition_checks.reason: Timing is structural DSL unresolvedness, not trained ASK confidence; no ask count/necessity metric or control.
Task-authoring time/SD reported, not per-clarification load.
Android Accessibility API and UI graph of visible/invisible objects; not pixel-only.
Native apps supported; web/custom-engine/gestural interfaces limited in §implementation.

unassigned: Persistent symbolic user-taught concepts are not agent-own-run retrieved experience (gui:C19) or automatic memory improvement.

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: Typed unresolved components delegate missing semantic information to user, then executable script/query runtime handles specified operations.
pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions_differences: Clarification is recursive grammar-directed human tutoring, not learned ASK confidence or automatic semantic verifier.

claims.text: GUI grounding reduces ambiguous conceptual language.
claims.setting: 58-person randomized formative elicitation, screenshots vs no screenshots.
claims.baseline_control: With/without app screenshot; two independent coders, 19% responses excluded.
claims.result: Ambiguous descriptions 33% control vs 9% screenshot, authors p<.05; kappa .87.
claims.denominator: 58 participants total; analyzed valid-response subset after quality exclusions.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Concrete app context helps specification in this formative setting, not causal proof of full Pumice benefit.

claims.text: Users can author tasks with conditionals and new concepts.
claims.setting: 10 users, four designed tasks, tutorial and relevant apps known.
claims.selection_vs_test: Tasks in random order; participants retry until satisfied; end script inspection.
claims.result: All 40 authoring tasks eventually completed; total 19.4–25 min per participant.
claims.denominator: 10 participants ×4 tasks, not 40 independent users or autonomous first-attempt trials.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Feasible and positively rated assisted authoring in lab, not superiority over manual execution or other systems.

claims.text: Generalized concepts are reusable across contexts.
claims.setting: Stored concepts/scripts plus four tasks; hot concept pre-taught in AC context.
claims.selection_vs_test: Preset memory/reuse scaffold; illustrative new-context dialogues.
claims.result: Reusable representation and observed designed task use; no longitudinal gain curve.
claims.denominator: One user-local knowledge base; no independent user/app transfer sample.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Supports scoped, user-confirmed reuse; no autonomous retained-improvement or unattended trigger claim.

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Ten trained users eventually authored and correctly executed four designed immediate-task automations each, using human-guided recursive concept grounding and app accessibility scripts.
unresolved: No controlled summative comparison or longitudinal reuse evaluation.
Exact app versions and independent historical originals unavailable.
assessment.reproduction: Author-reported participant study only, no execution by us.
